title: On a $q$-Skew Amitsur's Theorem
summary: Let $R$ be an algebra over an uncountable field, $σ$ a locally torsion automorphism and $δ$ a locally nilpotent left $σ$-derivation such that $qσδ= δσ$, where $q$ is a nonzero scalar. We show that the constant part of the Jacobson radical of the Ore extension $R[x;σ,δ]$ is nil. This partially answers a question of Greenfeld, Smoktunowicz and Ziembowski posed in 2019. As a corollary, we employ Shin's 2024 result to prove a q-skew Amitsur's theorem whenever the field is additionally assumed to be of characteristic zero.
